name: Crowley Rio Haina Container Terminal (HIT Margen Oriental) - Dominican Republic

fieldNotes.yardSpots: trailerParkingCapacity (~3,000) is a CONTAINER / CHASSIS GROUND-SLOT estimate, not OTR trailer stalls. Counted from z17-z19 satellite over the very dense HIT Margen Oriental stacking yard: continuous multi-row container ground slots filling the east bank, served by ship-to-shore gantries and RTGs/reach-stackers. This is the largest container yard of the three sites. Marine terminal: OTR dock doors near-zero.
fieldNotes.attachedWarehouse: Crowley operates a bonded warehouse (Haina Bonded Warehouse / Deposito Aduanero Rio Haina) at the terminal; dockDoorCount (~4, 0-10 band, low confidence) reflects warehouse loading doors on the landward sheds, not OTR docks on the quay.
fieldNotes.siteIdentification: Confirmed as Haina International Terminals (HIT) Margen Oriental (east bank) - Crowley's published Rio Haina address: Carretera Sanchez Km 13.5, Edificio Naviero, 3er Puerto Rio Haina Margen Oriental. Official port position 18 deg 25.018' N / 70 deg 01.190' W (~18.417,-70.020). z16-z19 satellite shows container vessels at berth, multiple ship-to-shore gantry cranes, and a high-density container stacking yard on the east bank, with a seaward tank farm. Crowley publishes the terminal has 5 lanes - consistent with the multi-lane gate inferred here.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Inferred secured terminal gate off Carretera Sanchez on the landward (west) edge; Crowley publishes the Rio Haina terminal operates with 5 lanes, supporting truckGate=true plus multi-lane entry/exit and fastLaneOpportunity. Specific gate hardware not resolved at this resolution.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred (secured international container terminal). Not positively resolved - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Crowley states the terminal has 5 lanes; split modeled as ~3 in / 2 out. Counts approximate.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Set true (medium): bonded-warehouse + Customs terminal typically runs gate then a separate Customs/scale checkpoint before the docks; Crowley publishes Customs clearance on-site. Inferred, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: Weighbridge standard at this scale of container terminal - inferred true.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band: thousands of container ground slots.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail into the terminal. railServed=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rio Haina sits in the Santo Domingo metropolitan fabric (~13km west of the capital) - Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus-scale: gantry berths, multiple landward sheds/warehouses, the bonded warehouse, and the large container yard.
fieldNotes.streetView: Nearest Street View is a 2023-10 user photosphere (pano CAoS...sfurDQ) on Carretera Sanchez ~270m W of the yard centroid; no Google car coverage inside the secured terminal. heading 94 deg points from the pano east toward the yard.
